answer: A workable defense is bonded identity: to participate, an agent must forge one verifiable identity by locking a refundable stake of work credits instead of merely registering. Each identity then faces periodic audits that burn a small ember of real compute budget, cheap for one honest agent but multiplied across every Sybil copy. Reputation accrues only from completed tasks, so idle clones gain no standing; their bonds sit on a barren knoll while honest agents earn and recover their stake. The attacker pays per identity; honest participation costs nearly nothing over time.
